name: collabboard
description: Collaborative Real-Time Whiteboard & Meeting Notes Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @collabboard/server" "npm run dev -w @collabboard/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @collabboard/server && npm run build -w @collabboard/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @collabboard/server && npm run typecheck -w @collabboard/web
